2023-4460-4518-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2558-4186-6701-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
2558-4186-6701-8095.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

4247-4681-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

4067-4247-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
4067-4247-5003-7848.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.
4067-4247-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

323-1981-2415-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Falkenrath Noble and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

628-6798-7865.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Dream Seizer.
When Dream Seizer dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dream Seizer enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat.

1563-2457-6965-7810.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

573-1479-3604.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Cadric (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Gruul Turf onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Gruul Turf trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1739-3375-4200-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Icewind Stalwart with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Icewind Stalwart from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Icewind Stalwart enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

5670-6705-7452.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5670-6705-7452.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

4613-4885-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-4885-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4885-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

628-5256-7200.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reluctant Dounguard.
When Reluctant Dounguard dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-6972-7154.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Condor.
When Arcbound Condor dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Condor's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Condor from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

232-876-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.

The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

3525-6006-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Pheres-Band Tromper.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

869-1987-4087-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Lavabrink Floodgates.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

536-1061-5778.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} available the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{U}{U} each following turn
536-1061-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
536-1061-5778.description:
Cast TImestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}, plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
When Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
If you control ten or more permanents and don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator token gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Riptide Laboratory by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning the nontoken Timestream Navigator from the battlefield to your hand.
During your next turn, repeat steps 1 through 5 one additional time.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator token by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 8.

81-1651-3715-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
81-1651-3715-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

539-2232-2374-3652.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
When Ornithopter enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Ashaya, Maja triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
When the Human Warrior enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

345-1992-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
"Knight" chosen with Metallic Mimic.
345-1992-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat.

1558-2397-4428-4840.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Myr Battlesphere.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers twice, creating eight 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Myrs, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

193-2696-3908-4235.notablePrerequisites:
You control an artifact, creature and/or land that can tap to produce at least {2}.
Aminatou has at least two loyalty counters.
193-2696-3908-4235.description:
Activate an artifact, land and/or creature you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting Teferi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Aminatou's ability, targeting Spark Double.
Resolve both Aminatou abilities, blinking Teferi and Spark Double, choosing to have Spark Double enter the battlefield as a copy of Aminatou.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting up to one land, artifact and/or creature.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Teferi ability, untapping up to land, artifact and/or creature you control and causing you to gain two life.
Activate an artifact, land and/or creature you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, targeting Teferi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Spark Double's ability, targeting Aminatou.
Resolve both Spark Double abilities, blinking Teferi and Aminatou.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting up to one land, artifact and/or creature.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, choose not to pay for the trigger.
Resolve the Teferi ability, untapping up to land, artifact and/or creature you control and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.
If the artifact, land and/or creature can produce at least {3}, you may instead use Teferi's second loyalty ability once you have infinite mana to put your library into your hand, or you may instead blink any other desired permanent.

2452-2974-5113-5220.description:
Cast Repository Skaab either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
When Repository Skaab enters the battlefield, its exploit ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Repository Skaab dies, Mortuary triggers, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1692-1953-2011-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Najeela.
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill enough of your creatures to end the combo.
1692-1953-2011-4050.description:
At the beginning of combat, Helm of the Host and Brudiclad trigger.
Resolve Helm of the Host's trigger, creating a nonlegendary copy of Najeela with haste.
Resolve Brudiclad's trigger, creating a token, then causing all tokens you control to become copies of the nonlegendary Najeela token with haste.
Attack with at least three Najeela creatures.
Each Najeela triggers at least three times each, creating a total of at least nine Warrior tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Activate Phyrexian Altar at least five times by sacrificing at least five Warrior tokens, adding at least {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Pay {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} to activate any Najeela, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink, and haste until end of turn, and creating an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage, gaining life equal to the amount of damage dealt.
Repeat.

2173-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Cryptic Trilobite enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

687-2599-3220-4050.description:
Sacrifice Ministrant of Obligation to Phyrexian Altar.
Pay {3} to activate Tayam's ability, removing the Vigilance counters from the created tokens.
Choose to return Ministrant of Obligation to the battlefield as Tayam's ability resolves.
Sacrifice Ministrant of Obligation and two tokens to Phyrexian Altar.
Repeat

1193-3227-4095.notablePrerequisites: There are permanents on the battlefield that enter the battlefield untapped and produce at least {3}{R}{R}.
1193-3227-4095.description:
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting anything but Salvager of Secrets.
In response, cast Radiate by paying {3}{R}{R}, creating copies of Mythos of Illuna that target each permanent besides the original target.
Resolve all copies of Mythos of Illuna besides the original, creating token copies of each permanent besides the original target.
The token copy of Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning Radiate from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the token lands or other mana-producing permanents created in step 3 by tapping them, adding at least {3}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2, doubling the number of copies created in step 3 each repetition.

224-3177-4300.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-3177-4300.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning the land from the battlefield to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Repeat.
